generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential integers starting at 1; unique; never NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Uniformly pick an existing parent key; 5% of rows get NULL only if the column is nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_code: Pick from the enum pool for the column; 10% near-variants (case flip, one-char edit) when no FK.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_text: Random lowercase word 3-12 chars; 5% near-duplicate of an existing value.
generic_sampling_rules.decimal_amount: Uniform in [0, 100000000] with 4 decimals; 5% boundary values near 6000.
generic_sampling_rules.double_pk: Sequential doubles starting at 0.0; unique; never NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.nullable_any: 5% NULL share; at least one NULL row per nullable column per instance.

issues.evidence: supporting_evidence drops 'Grants.grant_end_date >= grant_start_date' and 'Documents.response_received_date >= sent_date' as contradicted by compact rows, but the specification's semantic_rules_and_formulas still lists both. The program's _apply_formulas enforces them on generated rows only (compact rows are copied unchanged), so no integrity conflict arises; execution shows 0 not_null/fk/pk violations and 20/20 valid instances.
issues.requested_revision: Optional: mark these two formulas as 'generated-rows-only' in the spec, or move them to a separate 'uncertain' list, to avoid implying they hold on the compact data. Not blocking.

issues.evidence: nullable_columns shows 'Project_Outcomes.outcome_details: generated rows: NULL 300 / 300' and 'Project_Staff.other_details: NULL 211 / 211' and 'Tasks.eg Agree Objectives: NULL 300 / 300' — i.e. 100% NULL, no non-NULL rows. Per the interface rule (item 7) this is noted for the engineer but does not block. Cause: _null_share returns the compact share (1.0 for these columns), and _apply_null_rule sets k = round(share*n) = n, so every generated row is NULL.
issues.requested_revision: Optional: cap the planted NULL count at n-1 (or blend with the 5% floor) so at least one non-NULL row exists per nullable column, matching the 'rows with NULL and rows with non-NULL' wording. Not blocking.

issues.evidence: construction_pairs: eligible 60, separated 25, unknown_executions 0. The 35 unseparated pairs are not evidence of a generation bug: many are unmatched_join_rows / duplicates_for_distinct / ties_for_order_limit patterns whose separation depends on query shape, and the spec's boundary literals are planted via _apply_comparison_boundaries (e.g. grant_amount 5999.9999/6000/6000.0001, date_to 2016-03-15 00:33:18/19). Missing separation alone does not prove equivalence.
issues.requested_revision: None required; note that boundary planting is present in code and the remaining unseparated pairs are expected for these pattern families.
